volunteering.title: Volunteering as a continuous practice.
volunteering.description: Workshops, assemblies, and quiet acts of care — told at the same scale they were lived.

journal.title: Quiet entries, held open by typography and space.
journal.description: Reflections stay closer to the page: slower, lighter, and easier to read in one sitting.

trails.title: The body keeps a map of its own.
trails.description: Trails and runs that left a GPS trace — read at a glance, then opened up if the route asks for it.

stories.title: A looser space for making, testing, and wandering.
stories.description: Code, studio practice, and movement are allowed to collide here. The layout opens up, shifts weight, and lets different mediums speak at different volumes.

studioStatement.title: I treat websites like edited sequences, not stacks of panels.
studioStatement.description: The same attention goes into interface systems, sketchbook pages, running routes, and community gatherings: pacing, contrast, and where to leave silence so the next idea can land clearly.

focusAreas.title: Four threads, one practice.
items: Developer crafting durable and expressive digital systems.
Artist collecting texture, memory, and patient observation.
Runner using motion as a way to reorder thought.
Organizer shaping spaces where people can listen and act together.
